items.title: Coherent Jumps 12% as Optical Stocks Rebound From Wednesday’s AI Selloff; Applied Optoelectronics and Lumentum Rise 7%

items.title: Why Is Marvell Technology Stock Surging Today?
items.summary: Shares of Marvell Technology (NASDAQ:MRVL) surged 7. 3% in pre-market trading on Friday after the semiconductor manufacturer reported third-quarter fiscal 2027 results that exceeded Wall Street expectations.
